joins: each Employee (t1) to its Employee (t2), on Employee.ReportsTo = Employee.EmployeeId (declared key)
planner_note: Join Jane Peacock to the employee she reports to.
text: Shows Employee (t2) first name and Employee (t2) last name. Reads Employee (t1) and Employee (t2), where Employee (t1) first name is 'Jane' and Employee (t1) last name is 'Peacock'.
